name: DTF St. Louis
description: A love triangle among three adults experiencing middle-age malaise leads to one of them ending up dead.

videos.title: Cornhole
videos.overview: When Clark and Floyd learn that both their marriages have stalled, they begin to explore a new dating app for extramarital affairs.

videos.title: Snag It
videos.overview: After meeting at the cornhole party, Clark quickly hits it off with Floyd's wife Carol. Later, detectives Homer and Plumb dig deeper into Clark's relationship with Carol – and Floyd's time on the DTF app.

videos.title: The Go Getter
videos.overview: When Detective Plumb discovers that Carol has lied about key details of her affair, she presses Homer to let her question Clark. Once in the hot seat, unsettling truths about Clark's relationships with both Floyd and Carol begin to come to light.

videos.title: Missouri Mutual Life & Health Insurance Company
videos.overview: Eager to please, Clark ramps up his support for Floyd's health and financial wellness, while Carol makes her lover swear to secrecy.

videos.title: Amphezyne
videos.overview: Floyd confronts Clark about the affair. Plumb and Homer uncover new information about Carol's past.

videos.title: The Denny's Plan
videos.overview: Floyd's ego takes a hit after a failed attempt to reconnect with Carol, leading Clark to help his friend using the DTF app.

videos.title: No One's Normal. It Just Looks That Way from Across the Street
videos.overview: With Tiger Tiger out of the picture, Clark proposes a new plan. After a series of revelations, Plumb and Homer are forced to question everything they thought they knew about the case.
